**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] User owns a 2015 Ford Mustang GT.
- [EVENT] User attended a dyno tuning session on May 15th, where they fine-tuned the engine's calibration to optimize power output.
- [PREFERENCE] User is considering upgrading their fuel injector system and is looking for recommendations on top brands and models compatible with their Mustang.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended brands and models for fuel injectors compatible with the 2015 Ford Mustang GT:
  - Bosch EV14 Fuel Injector (compatible with 2015-2017 Mustang GT)
  - DeatschWerks 95lb/hr Fuel Injector (compatible with 2015-2017 Mustang GT)
  - Fuel Injector Clinic 95lb/hr Fuel Injector (compatible with 2015-2017 Mustang GT)
  - Siemens Deka 95lb/hr Fuel Injector (compatible with 2015-2017 Mustang GT)
  - Injector Dynamics ID1300x Fuel Injector (compatible with 2015-2017 Mustang GT)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested factors to consider when selecting a fuel injector:
  - Flow rate
  - Compatibility
  - Quality
- [PREFERENCE] User is leaning towards the DeatschWerks 95lb/hr Fuel Injector.
- [EVENT] User learned about their FuelTech fuel management system during the "Turbocharged Tuesdays" event at the local speedway on June 14th.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Confirmed that the DeatschWerks 95lb/hr Fuel Injector is a good match for the FuelTech system but recommended verifying:
  - Fuel injector compatibility with FuelTech documentation
  - Fuel pressure compatibility
  - Injector pulse width modulation (PWM) support
  - Tuning and calibration needs after installation
- [PREFERENCE] User is considering getting their car tuned again after the fuel injector upgrade.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested ways to find reputable tuners in the user's area:
  - FuelTech dealer locator
  - Mustang forums and communities
  - Word of mouth from friends and local performance shops
  - Online review sites
- [FACT] User is located in the local area of the speedway where they participated in the "Turbocharged Tuesdays" event.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended asking event organizers or participants for tuner recommendations and visiting local performance shops.
